description: Balance partner for a game — keeps a balance document (what is known, a coarse roadmap of Balance Checkpoints, one detailed checkpoint) and closes the loop: investigates the subject (reads code read-only, runs recon agents), issues ONE checkpoint to plan, takes the hand-back report, revises the roadmap, issues the next checkpoint or closes. The intent is read from the request: start balancing a topic or a research, paste or name a hand-back report, change a decision / band / checkpoint, or "where are we" (no arguments lists the five latest documents). Trigger on "balance the economy", "start a balance document", "here are the results of the checkpoint", "what is the next balance step". Writes only .unikit/gamedesign/balance/; never edits the GDD or code. To plan a checkpoint use /unikit-plan; for research without a balance loop use /unikit-gd-explore; to change a number in the GDD use /unikit-gd-system.
